headline: Laver Cup Day 1 at The O2: Ruud vs Cerúndolo and Mensik vs Nakashima open London ties
whyCareReason: The 9th Laver Cup is live Friday at The O2 in London with Casper Ruud facing Francisco Cerúndolo and Jakub Mensik playing Brandon Nakashima in opening singles.
teaser: Friday 25 September at The O2. Day session from 13:00 local: Ruud vs Cerúndolo, Mensik vs Nakashima. Night session: singles and doubles.
story:
Why this one matters: The iconic black court at The O2 in London lights up on Friday 25 September as Team Europe and Team World battle for the 9th Laver Cup.

Captains Yannick Noah and Andre Agassi announced the Day 1 order of play: Casper Ruud opens against Francisco Cerúndolo at 13:00 UK time, followed by Jakub Menšík against Brandon Nakashima. The night session features a marquee singles tie followed by opening doubles.

Format: Friday wins earn one point each, Saturday two points, Sunday three points. The first team to 13 points lifts the trophy.
stakes: The first team tennis date after the US Open. Every Friday win secures one point toward the 13 required.
rivalryAngle: Europe against the rest of the world, in a building that already hosted this event in 2022.
